subject: Software as a Service with Shiny

messages.author: 9a5a99b0079d2104
messages.subject: Software as a Service with Shiny
parts: Hi, I have been providing consultancy for a certain subject by using mainly R Studio as my tool. All my code is in R. Within my organisation we have a plan to use this logic for a web service with an interface. We were considering porting the R code to a web language but we came across Shiny. What I was wondering was if anyone knew if this was a good idea to do in Shiny considering we need to keep the R code private, (is this the usual way in Shiny?) and whether incorporating Shiny into a custom made user login with subscription, etc... is a possibility?

messages.author: dc3c7e88d9ea3297
messages.subject: Re: Software as a Service with Shiny
parts:
Sure that's what we do and you can change the log-in.

Chris
